issues.title: Move member photos out of public/ behind a signed URL

changes/schedule-phone.title: Lane schedule fits a phone screen
changes/schedule-phone.summary: The schedule was a five-column table that scrolled sideways on phones, which is where 81% of its views come from. It is now one card per hour.
changes/schedule-phone.why: Members check lane times poolside. Request logs: 4,210 schedule views last month, 3,410 from phones.
changes/schedule-phone.evidence: Playwright at 390 px: page width 620 px before, 390 px after.
changes/schedule-phone.verified: System test for the schedule at phone width; checked live after deploy.

changes/slow-tests.title: Stop three tests sleeping through real retry backoff
changes/slow-tests.summary: WeatherClient retried with real sleeps in tests. Stubbing the clock cut the suite from 211 s to 58 s.
changes/slow-tests.measure: Suite 211 s → 58 s, same 1,412 tests passing

changes/dead-mailer.title: Remove the WaitlistMailer and its four templates
changes/dead-mailer.summary: Nothing has sent it since the waitlist feature was removed in March.
changes/dead-mailer.evidence: No callers (grepped mailer name, deliver_later, the four template names, and the jobs); mail log shows zero sends since 2026-03-14.

changes/stale-docs.title: Fix the README's setup steps
changes/stale-docs.summary: It still says to run bin/setup with Redis. The app moved to Solid Queue and has no Redis.

changes/unused-gems.title: Drop the chartkick gem
changes/unused-gems.summary: A reviewer called it unused. It isn't: the admin dashboard loads it through a helper. Dropped as wrong.
